reason: Three free months costs me nothing, and I like the idea of actually knowing which of my regulars come in and rewarding them without punch cards. I'd try Guest Loop, but I'm not promising to pay 59 lari after the trial unless it shows me something.
objection: The per-transaction fee on top of my card terminal fee. Money is tight, and if guests pay by QR I might end up paying two fees for the same coffee. Plus my regulars already pay at the counter, so I'm not sure they'd bother scanning.
would_change_my_mind: If after the trial the transaction fee turns out higher than my bank terminal, or fewer than a handful of guests actually use the QR, I cancel.
